text: City Council on July 14, 15, and 16, 2021 adopted Item IE23.13 - "Port Lands Flood Protection - Lake Shore Boulevard East Trail and Lower Don Trail Construction Closures and Detour Routes" (http://app.toronto.ca/tmmis/viewAgendaItemHistory.do?item=2021.IE23.13). Some errors and omissions in the recommendations have since been discovered and require correction. In addition, parking amendments on Villiers Street, between Cherry Street and Don Roadway are required to address safety concerns. As such, a reopening and amendment of the Item is required. The required amendments include the installation of temporary traffic control signals at the intersection of Commissioners Street and Saulter Street South and rescinding of traffic control signals at the intersection of Commissioners Street and Cherry Street.
